title: A sidebar that's easier to scan, and a more visible Content page
items: The sidebar's 16 icons now sit in labeled groups (Games, Competition, Model, Content, Community, More) with dividers between them, and every icon has a hover tooltip — the sidebar has no visible text labels outside the guided tour, so there was previously no way to tell them apart without hovering blind.
The Content link in the top bar is now a filled accent button instead of a small text link, since that's a more effective spot for it than adding a 17th unlabeled sidebar icon.
